name: Bjørn Halvorsen
bio:
Bjørn's path to motorsport analysis started unconventionally, with a degree in theoretical physics. He found himself drawn to the complex datasets generated by racing, recognizing the potential to unlock performance gains. After honing his skills at a small aerodynamics firm, he transitioned to karting, where he was recruited by Birel ART for his knack for finding hidden patterns within telemetry data.

Bjørn's approach is systematic and detail-oriented. He obsesses over every variable, from tire temperature gradients to subtle engine performance fluctuations. He's known for his ability to translate complex data into actionable insights that engineers and drivers can readily understand. His perfectionist nature and ability to remain calm under pressure make him an invaluable asset during race weekends, able to synthesize information quickly and accurately under tight deadlines.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Bjørn is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small, leather-bound notebook to jot down observations.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking exactly three cups of black coffee each morning.
